api.label: API
api.tagline: Full control from your own stack — API keys, signed webhooks, and just-in-time code minting.

shopify.label: Shopify
shopify.tagline: Connect your store once — POWR mints a fresh single-use discount per redemption and marks it used at your checkout.

manual.label: Promo Codes
manual.tagline: Upload or generate batches of codes right here in the portal — no development work at all.

codeAssigned.label: Code assigned
codeAssigned.description: A member redeemed a reward and was handed one of your codes.

codeUsed.label: Code used
codeUsed.description: A code was confirmed as used in your system (via reconciliation).

poolLow.label: Pool running low
poolLow.description: A reward’s available code stock dipped below your threshold.

voucherConfirmed.label: Voucher confirmed in store
voucherConfirmed.description: Your staff scanned a member’s in-store voucher at the till.

voucherSwiped.label: Voucher swiped in store
voucherSwiped.description: Your staff swiped a member’s in-store voucher on their phone (shown, not scanned).

shared.copyFailed: Could not copy — select it manually

setup.allDone: All set — this now runs itself

wrongMethod.body: Your rewards currently deliver via {{current}}. You can prepare {{here}} here, but it won't take over until you switch methods.

fallback.title: Fallback Codes
fallback.body: Keep a small buffer of pre-loaded codes — if your integration is ever unavailable at redemption time, POWR falls back to the pool automatically so members never hit a wall.

hub.titleFirstRun: How will you deliver rewards to members?
hub.title: Delivery method
hub.introFirstRun: When a member redeems one of your rewards, POWR hands them a code. Pick how those codes reach us — you can change this at any time.
hub.intro: How codes reach members when they redeem your rewards. Switching is non-destructive — existing setup keeps working.
hub.confirmSwitch: Switch your delivery method to {{method}}? Nothing is deleted — your existing setup keeps working and you can switch back anytime.
hub.decideLater: Not sure yet? Decide later — you can pick a method anytime from the sidebar

api.intro: Automate your code supply and usage reconciliation in four steps — push codes, hear about redemptions the second they happen, and skip the CSV uploads entirely.

toast.loadFailed: Some data failed to load — refresh to retry ({{reason}})

confirm.revokeKey: Revoke this key? Integrations using it will stop working immediately.
confirm.deleteEndpoint: Delete this endpoint? Its delivery history goes with it.

key.title: Create an API key
key.detail: Your server authenticates every call with a bearer key — create one and store it somewhere safe.

webhook.title: Add a webhook endpoint
webhook.detail: We POST signed events to your system the moment they happen — a code is assigned, a code is used, a pool runs low, a voucher is confirmed or swiped in store.

jit.title: Turn on just-in-time minting
jit.detail: The deepest integration — POWR asks your endpoint for a fresh code at each redemption. Skip it if you'd rather pre-load code pools.
jit.summary: On — POWR mints from your endpoint at redemption time.

verify.title: Verify the integration
verify.detail: Fire a signed test at everything you've wired up and watch it come back green.

keys.freshTitle: Copy your new key now — it will not be shown again
keys.empty: No API keys yet. Create one to start calling the API.
keys.pingHint: Then prove it works from your server: GET {{url}}/ping with the key as a bearer token. Full details in the API docs.

webhooks.empty: No endpoints yet. Add one and we'll POST signed events to it as they happen.

deliveries.title: Recent Deliveries
deliveries.empty: Nothing delivered yet. Events appear here the moment members interact with your rewards.

jit.intro: When a member redeems, POWR asks your endpoint for a fresh single-use code — no pre-loaded pools, no reconciliation. Applies to rewards set to API-validated delivery. Keep a small buffer of pool codes loaded as a fallback for outages.
jit.thresholdHint: We send pool.low when a reward's available codes dip to this level. 0 turns it off.
jit.mintOk: Mint endpoint working — responded in {{ms}}ms with a valid code ({{code}}).
jit.mintOkWarning: Mint endpoint working — responded in {{ms}}ms with a valid code ({{code}}). ⚠ {{warning}}

verify.intro: One click fires a signed test event at every active webhook endpoint — plus a probe of your mint endpoint if you've configured one — and shows you exactly what came back.
verify.mintResponded: Responded in {{ms}}ms with a valid code
verify.mintRespondedWarning: Responded in {{ms}}ms with a valid code — {{warning}}
verify.noEndpoint: No active endpoint to test — add one below.

key.label: API key
key.none: No key yet — create one in step 1.
key.unused: Key created but never used — try GET /v1/ping from your server.

webhook.label: Webhook endpoint
webhook.autoDisabled: Your endpoint was auto-disabled after repeated failures — fix it, then re-enable it in step 2.
webhook.none: No endpoint yet — add one in step 2 to hear about redemptions live.
webhook.failing_one: {{count}} recent delivery failed — check your receiver, or hit Test.
webhook.failing_other: {{count}} recent deliveries failed — check your receiver, or hit Test.
webhook.active: Endpoint active — verify in step 4 to confirm it receives signed events.

jit.label: Just-in-time minting
jit.none: Optional — configure it in step 3 if you want codes minted from your system at redemption time.
jit.paused: Paused after repeated mint failures — test your endpoint in step 3; it resumes automatically.
jit.on: On — POWR asks your endpoint for a fresh code at each redemption.
jit.off: Configured but off — run "Test mint endpoint" in step 3, then turn it on.

shopify.intro: The zero-effort integration: three steps and every redemption mints a fresh single-use code in your store — marked used the moment it's spent at your checkout. No CSVs, no API work, nothing to host.

toast.unreachable: Couldn't reach Shopify — your store's connection is unchanged, retry in a moment
toast.connected: Shopify connected — pick which discount each reward mints from
toast.mapped: Reward now mints from that discount

shopify.confirmDisconnect: Disconnect Shopify? Minting stops immediately; mapped rewards fall back to any buffer pool codes.

connect.title: Connect your store
connect.detail: Approve the POWR app on your Shopify store — one click, no code, takes a minute.

map.title: Pick a discount for each reward
map.detailUnmapped_one: {{count}} live reward still has no discount behind it — pick one for each below.
map.detailUnmapped_other: {{count}} live rewards still have no discount behind them — pick one for each below.
map.detail: Create a template discount in Shopify, then choose it here — POWR clones it into a fresh single-use code per redemption.
map.summaryLive_one: {{mapped}} of {{count}} live reward minting from your discounts
map.summaryLive_other: {{mapped}} of {{count}} live rewards minting from your discounts

test.title: Test the full loop
test.detail: Mint a real test code and spend it at your own checkout — proves minting and order tracking end to end.
test.summary: Full loop proven — minted, spent at checkout, confirmed back to POWR.

connect.unreachable: Couldn't reach Shopify just now, so we can't show your store's status. Nothing has changed at your end — if you were connected, you still are, and minting carries on.
connect.uninstalled: The POWR app was uninstalled from your store — reconnect below to resume minting.
connect.approveHint: You'll approve the POWR Rewards app on Shopify's screen and land straight back here.
connect.sessionExpired: Shopify session expired — hit Connect Shopify again to restore minting and order tracking.
connect.ordersInactive: Order tracking isn't active yet, so used codes won't confirm automatically. In your Shopify app settings, approve “Protected customer data” access (reason: app functionality), then reload this page — it repairs itself.

map.waiting: Waiting on your store — retry in step 1 and your Shopify discounts will appear here to choose from.
map.connectFirst: Connect your store first — your Shopify discounts will appear here to choose from.
map.discountsFailed: Couldn't load the discounts in your store, so the pickers below stay locked. Any mapping you already have keeps minting.
map.noRewards: No rewards yet — create one in My Rewards and it appears here. It doesn't need to be live in the app to wire up minting.
map.noDiscountsBody: We couldn't find a discount in your store that POWR can copy. Create one in Shopify — percentage or fixed amount off, no code needed — then refresh and it appears here for every reward.
map.notMinting: Not minting yet — pick a discount
map.templateHint: Create the template discount in Shopify (percentage or fixed amount) — POWR clones it into a single-use code per redemption. Codes confirm as used automatically when spent at your checkout.

test.waiting: Waiting on your store — retry in step 1.
test.mapFirst: Map a reward to a discount in step 2 first.
test.intro: Mints one single-use code from your mapped template — exactly like a member redemption, just without the member. Apply it at your own checkout and watch it confirm as used automatically.
test.loopWorks: The full loop works: minted in Shopify, spent at checkout, confirmed back to POWR.
test.realCode: This is a real single-use discount in your store (it expires in 7 days). Place a test order with it — the status here flips to Used within a minute.

connection.label: Store connection
connection.unreachable: Couldn't reach Shopify just now — retry in step 1 to see your store's health.
connection.none: Not connected yet — start with step 1.
connection.expired: Session expired — reconnect in step 1 to restore minting.

orders.label: Order tracking
orders.none: Activates automatically when your store connects.
orders.live: Live — codes spent at your checkout confirm as used by themselves.
orders.inactive: Not active — approve “Protected customer data” in your Shopify app settings, then reload.

minting.label: Reward minting
minting.none: No rewards minting yet — map one in step 2.
